name: Normative iEEG atlases (MNI Open iEEG Atlas + HUP interictal and sleep/wake atlases)

access.licence: MNI: account; HUP atlas ODC-By; sleep/wake CC BY-NC-SA
access.steps: Request an MNI account; Pennsieve download for HUP atlases.

cohort.age: epilepsy patients, channels from presumed healthy tissue
cohort.types: MNI: 1,772 normal channels from 106 subjects; HUP atlas merged MNI + Penn data, 166 subjects, >5,000 channels

modalities: Interictal iEEG clips (60 s awake; sleep stages in later releases), normal channels only
format: Processed clips + z-score tables; channels in common stereotaxic space
size: HUP interictal atlas 0.3 GB; sleep/wake atlas 4.4 GB
labels: Normal vs SOZ channels in the HUP atlas papers
derived: Band power and coherence norms by region
caveats: Channels come from epilepsy patients, not healthy people
HUP and MNI atlases partly overlap (HUP merged MNI data)
checks: MNI portal page; Pennsieve readmes; abstracts of Frauscher 2018 and Bernabei 2022.
pipeline: Turns any patient's iEEG into regional z-scores: a cheap abnormality prior and a sanity check on simulated 'healthy' nodes (Bernabei 2022 AUC 0.77 for SOZ vs normal).
key_claim: Normative regional iEEG maps (106–166 subjects) for z-scoring patient channels.

evidence.quote: A total of 1785 channels with normal brain activity from 106 patients were identified.
1772 channels with normal brain activity from 106 subjects, registered to a common stereotaxic space
we aggregated interictal intracranial EEG retrospectively across 166 subjects comprising >5000 channels
